title: Effects (prompt-level only)
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Effects are prompt cues the model approximates. They are not post-production filters.

entries.label: Slow motion
entries.prompt: The action plays in smooth slow motion, with every droplet and fabric ripple drifting and hanging in the air.
entries.notes: This is a prompt cue; the model approximates the look, it does not retime footage.

entries.label: Rain
entries.prompt: Steady rain falls, with glistening wet surfaces, rippling puddles and fine droplets catching the light.
entries.notes: Pairs with reflections and neon or street light.

entries.label: Snow
entries.prompt: Soft snow drifts down in large flakes, settling on shoulders and the ground, with a hushed feel.

entries.label: Fog and haze
entries.prompt: Low fog and atmospheric haze drift through the scene, softening the distance and glowing around light sources.

entries.label: Sparks
entries.prompt: Bright sparks spray and arc through the air, glowing orange and fading as they fall.

entries.label: Lens flare
entries.prompt: A soft anamorphic lens flare streaks across the frame as the light source passes the lens.

entries.label: Handheld shake
entries.prompt: The camera has a subtle handheld shake, with small organic movements that feel documentary and alive.
entries.notes: Combine with documentary styling; avoid for product hero shots.

entries.label: Speed ramp
entries.prompt: The motion ramps from slow to fast in a sudden speed ramp, accelerating into the action.

entries.label: Floating particles
entries.prompt: Fine dust particles float and glitter in the light beams, drifting slowly through the air.
